content.text:
Priya, you were charged twice, and you are owed ₹999 back.

Order ORD-2201 was a single annual Pro renewal for ₹999. Two payments settled against it on 19 August: payment 123 at 10:15:02 and payment 124 at 10:15:05, three seconds apart, ₹999 each. Each one carries its own checkout key, so this was the payment being submitted twice rather than one attempt being retried by your bank.

I have opened ticket #1 at high priority asking a colleague to refund payment 124 and leave payment 123 in place, with the payment ids and timestamps already attached so nobody has to ask you for them. You do not need to do anything else.
